arabic text: TERA CHEHLUM MANANE GHURBAT PE\nQAID KHANE SE AAGAYI ZAINAB
english translation text: ZAINAB AS COME FROM THE PRISON\nTO COMMEMORATE YOUR 40TH IN LONELINESS

arabic text: BHAIYYA... AAGAYI ZAINAB
english translation text: BROTHER… ZAINAB HAS COME

arabic text: PAAS TERE TERI SAKINA KO\nSAATH APNE NA LAA SAKI ZAINAB
english translation text: ZAINAB COULD NOT BRING\nSAKINA WITH HER TO YOU

arabic text: HAYE ATTHARA BHAIYO WALI\nBERIDA SHAAM HOKE AAYI HAI
english translation text: OH THE ONE WITH 18 BROTHERS\nHAS COME FROM SHAM WITHOUT ANY COVERING

arabic text: NEEL ZAKHMO KE AUR BAAZU PAR\nRASSIYO KE NISHAAN LAAYI HAI
english translation text: WITH BRUISED WOUNDS AND ARMS\nCOVERED WITH MARKS OF ROPES

arabic text: TUNE PAALA THA JISKO NAAZO SE\nAB WO ZAINAB NAHI RAHI ZAINAB
english translation text: AFTER YOU RAISED HER WITH SUCH CARE\nNOW THAT ZAINAB, ISN’T THAT ZAINAB ANYMORE

arabic text: ITNE CHHALE PADE HAI PAYRO MEIN\nMUJHSE BHAIYYA CHALA NAHI JAATA
english translation text: I HAVE SO MANY BLISTERS IN MY FEET\nBROTHER I CAN’T WALK ANYMORE

arabic text: DIL YE KEHTA HAI KEHDU SAB TUMSE\nPAR ZUBAA SE KAHA NAHI JAATA
english translation text: MY HEART SAYS TO TELL YOU EVERYTHING\nMY TONGUE DOESN’T LET ME SPEAK ANYMORE

arabic text: KABHI KAATO'N BHARI ZAMEE'N PE CHALI\nAUR KABHI AAG PAR CHALI ZAINAB
english translation text: SOMETIMES, ZAINAB WALKED ON THORNES AND\nSOMETIMES SHE WALKED ON FIRE

arabic text: BEKASI MAA KI YAAD AATI THI\nAPNI GHURBAT KO BHOOL JAATI THI
english translation text: REMEMBERING MY HELPLESS MOTHER\nI USED TO FORGET MY OWN SITUATION

arabic text: MUJHKO DARBAAR MEIN SHARABI KE\nAMMA ZAHRA KI YAAD AATI THI
english translation text: IN THE COURT OF THE DRUNKARD,\nI USED TO REMEMBER MY MOTHER ZAHRA

arabic text: SAR JHUKAYE KHADI RAHI ZAINAB\nLOG TERI BAHAN PE HASTE THE
english translation text: PEOPLE USED TO LAUGH AT YOUR SISTER (ZAINAB)\nAS SHE STOOD WITH HER HEAD LOWERED

arabic text: SHEHR E KUFA KE LOG HAS HAS KAR\nHAYE MERI JANIB ISHARE KARTE THE
english translation text: THE PEOPLE OF KUFA USED TO\nPOINT AND LAUGH AT ME

arabic text: JIS SE SAJJAD NE RIDA MAANGI\nUSNE MAARE GHAREEB KO PATTHAR
english translation text: WHEN SAJJAD ASKED FOR A HEAD\nCOVER, THEY HIT HIM WITH STONES

arabic text: AAKHRI SAANS TAK NA BHULEGI\nKUFE WALO KI BE RUKHI ZAINAB
english translation text: TILL HER LAST BREATH ZAINAB WILL NOT FORGET\nTHE CRUELTY OF THE PEOPLE OF KUFA

arabic text: WO JO PUCHEGI APNE AKBAR KA\nJAAKE SUGHRA KO KYA BATAUNGI
english translation text: WHEN SHE ASKS ABOUT HER AKBAR\nWHAT WILL I TELL SUGHRA?

arabic text: SAATH TERA AGAR NAHI HOGA\nQABR PE MAA KE KAISE JAUNGI
english translation text: HOW WILL SHE GO TO THE\nGRAVE OF MOTHER WITHOUT YOU

arabic text: AYE GHAREEB UL WATAN BAGHAIR TERE\nLAUT KAR GHAR NA JAYEGI ZAINAB
english translation text: OH STRANGER WITHOUT YOU\nZAINAB WON’T GO HOME

arabic text: HAYE KABHI TAKTI THI WO TERE SAR KO\nKABHI ABBAS KO BULATI THI
english translation text: OH WHEN SHE USED TO STROKE YOUR (HUSSAIN)\nHEAD, SOMETIMES SHE USED TO CALL ABBAS

arabic text: MERI AANKHO'N KE SAAMNE BHAIYYA\nTERI BACHHI TAMACHE KHATI THI
english translation text: IN FRONT OF MY EYES BROTHER\nYOUR DAUGHTER WAS SLAPPED

arabic text: HAATH MERE BANDHE THE GARDAN SE\nSHIMR KO KAISE ROKTI ZAINAB
english translation text: MY HAND WERE TIED TO MY NECK\nHOW COULD I STOP SHIMR?

arabic text: QABR E MAZLOOM PAR TAKALLUM YE\nKEH RAHI THI BATOOL KI JAYI
english translation text: ON THE GRAVE OF THE OPPRESSED,\nTAKALLUM, BATOOL’S BELOVED WAS SAYING,

arabic text: TUJH SE WADA BAHAN YE KARTI HAI\nKHATM HO JAYEGI YE TANHAYI
english translation text: SHE HAS PROMISED YOU\nTHAT THIS LONELINESS WILL END

arabic text: TERA CHEHLUM MANAYEGI DUNIYA\nIBTEDA AAJ KAR CHUKI ZAINAB
english translation text: YOUR 40TH WILL BE COMMEMORATE BY THE\nWHOLE WORLD. ZAINAB HAS STARTED IT TODAY
